7z-wasm 1.2.0 (https://github.com/use-strict/7z-wasm, npm `7z-wasm`): 7-Zip 24.09
compiled to WebAssembly. GNU LGPL 2.1 with the unRAR restriction (License.txt,
unRarLicense.txt); unmodified. The installer (web/pages/install-worker.js)
loads it only when the player picks a .7z or .rar, to unpack the disc rip.
The unRAR code may not be used to develop a RAR (WinRAR) compatible archiver.
